diagnoses.analysis: This is the aggregate required-status job, not an independent source failure. Its frozen log runs exit 1; .github/workflows/reusable-pr-build.yml:62-89 explicitly fails when common or test-latest-deps fails. The other thirty failed keys are explained by the gRPC, Thrift, and Sofa RPC assertion mismatches fixed in the three candidate commits. No workflow modification or rerun-only request is warranted.

The synchronous handler behind the nonblocking Thrift server serializes its failure without retaining a throwable. The PR intentionally classifies that failed response as _OTHER. clientAsyncWithError still called helpers expecting no server error.type. Both its library/no-network and agent/network assertion branches now expect _OTHER through the existing preview-gated helper. The frozen assertion explicitly reports expected null but actual _OTHER. Local execution remains unavailable because fixture generation requires Docker; no passing Thrift execution is claimed.

The PR now classifies terminal gRPC UNKNOWN statuses as error.type=UNKNOWN. errorThrown still omitted error.type from the exact client attributes and expected StatusRuntimeException on the server. The shared test now expects UNKNOWN on both roles, gated to preview/duplicate conventions. The existing interceptor explicitly ends thrown handler failures with Status.UNKNOWN, so production behavior is intentional.

metadata.body:
<!--
CHANGELOG.md is generated from merged pull requests. Do not add an entry unless this PR introduces
a deprecation or breaking change.
-->

Adds bounded `error.type` to new and duplicate RPC telemetry for terminal failures while preserving legacy output.

- **gRPC:** Classify terminal status codes by client/server role; omit server cancellations.
- **Thrift:** Classify serialized failures as `_OTHER` when no throwable survives, retaining more-specific classifications otherwise.
- **Metrics:** Include `error.type` in advice for new RPC duration histograms only.
- **Dubbo:** End provider spans on asynchronous completion across supported 2.7 API shapes.
metadata.title: Capture terminal error.type for new RPC telemetry
